advisor_identified: Historian and Canada Research Chair in Atlantic Canada Studies at the University of New Brunswick, appointed in 2012.

doctorate.title: Two Patterns of New England Transformation: Machias, Maine, and Liverpool, Nova Scotia, 1760-1820

evidence.says: UNB's archived History faculty listing identifies Elizabeth Mancke as a professor and Canada Research Chair appointed in 2012, and lists her PhD institution as Johns Hopkins.

Johns Hopkins University's 1990 commencement program, printed page 100, lists Elizabeth Mancke in History under Doctors of Philosophy in the School of Arts and Sciences, with the matching dissertation on Machias, Maine, and Liverpool, Nova Scotia, 1760-1820.

notes: The linked record matches the advisor's institution, year, department and dissertation title. Its spelling 'Novia Scotia' is a typographical error; the university commencement program gives 'Nova Scotia'.
